description: The map portal of the Municipality of Tórshavn, the capital of the Faroe Islands, lists the municipality's public and internal web maps and dashboards. The overview read on 2026-09-28 includes maps of addresses and municipal cadastral parcels, water mains and fittings, sewers (internal) and sewer statistics that can be filtered by pipe material and construction year, street lights, parking, building permit cases, geothermal permits, a public heat atlas showing energy plans, geothermal boreholes and district heating pipes, a dashboard of estimated building energy demand, drone imagery, survey points, the 2022 bus route with distances from homes to stops, current and planned road works restrictions, green areas and cemeteries. Coverage is the Tórshavn municipality. Access is free for the public maps; several maps are marked for internal use, and no licence or download is stated. Caveats: viewing is in the browser only, and which layers are public must be checked map by map. It supports network models and hazard exposure studies of a small island capital's water, sewer, district heating and bus networks. No related Faroe Islands infrastructure record is catalogued.
